issues.issue: Did the IAD err by taking into account Mr. Brace's youth record and the number of offences?
issues.applicant_position: First conviction occurred as a youth and should not have been taken into account.
issues.result_quote: it was not only proper, but also essential, that the Member consider all of Mr. Brace’s criminal activity while in Canada.

issues.issue: Did the IAD fail to consider the best interests of the unborn child of his pregnant girlfriend?
issues.applicant_position: IAD gave a boilerplate nod to children's interests with no analysis of the evidence.
issues.result_quote: There was an insufficient evidentiary basis for the IAD to make any meaningful assessment.

issues.issue: Did the IAD apply a stricter standard of proof, given its repeated use of the word 'convinced'?
issues.applicant_position: Repeated use of 'convinced' shows the IAD applied a standard stricter than balance of probabilities.
issues.result_quote: there is nothing in the reasons, read as a whole, to suggest that the IAD was assessing the situation on a standard more stringent than on a balance of probabilities.
